reigns.note: Bastard son of Orestes who seized Lesbos and began the Aeolian migration to Asia Minor — ancestor of the colonists who settled the coast where Smyrna stood as one of the twelve Aeolian cities.
Son of Echelas and grandson of Penthilus; led the Lacedaemonian and Achaean colonists who occupied Aeolis, of which Smyrna was one of the twelve cities on the site still called the old town.
Ionians who set out from Colophon and displaced the Aeolians at the old town; the Ionians later allowed the Smyrnaeans a seat at the Panionium assembly.
During the raids that preceded the Trojan War, Achilles took Smyrna among the coastal cities of Asia Minor.
